title: KNUCKLES HOME MUSCLES
author: Knuckles (MR Muscle)
desc:
This is a beginner friendly at home workout plan, for those who wanna get bigger and stronger but dont have the equipment, dont worry,

KNUCKLES HAS UR BACK!

This at home workout will do everything you want or need, just trust the process, it may be slower then actually going to the gym, but it works all the same.

ex.note:
• Aim for 2-3 sets of as many reps as possible
• 2 mins rest

• Aim for 2-3 sets of 8-10 reps
• 2 mins rest

• Aim for 2-3 sets of 10-12 reps
• 90 seconds rest

• Aim for 2-3 sets of 1 minute each side
• 2-3 mins rest

• Aim for 2-3 sets of 6-8 reps
• 2 mins rest
• grab 2 back packs and hold them with each hand, fill them both up with the same weight, and lift
